name: Flux Lines
description: Full-size WebGL2 background of flowing, glowing contour lines driven by layered noise, with palette coloring, cursor magnet distortion, click swirl and an intro fade-in.
contents: Container div filling its parent with an absolutely positioned WebGL2 canvas
Fragment shader drawing animated noise contour lines tinted by a color palette
behavior: Lines flow continuously in the chosen direction with noise turbulence and shimmer
Cursor creates a smoothly following magnet that twists the lines nearby
Click or tap triggers a decaying swirl at the pointer
Intro reveal fades lines in over 1.8 seconds
Rendering pauses when offscreen or tab hidden, and motion stops with prefers-reduced-motion
Light mode draws dark ink lines for light backgrounds; transparent false paints a solid background
editableByProps: Line colors (up to 8), opacity, glow, sharpness, line width and rim width
Flow direction, speed, scale, turbulence, fluidity and shimmer
Cursor and click interaction toggles and strength, radius, dampening
Intro, pause, light mode, transparent or solid background color
Pixel ratio cap, blend mode, className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change contour level or noise pattern shape
needsCodeEdit.where: FRAGMENT shader main function and FIELD noise functions

needsCodeEdit.change: Change click swirl strength or duration
needsCodeEdit.where: twist calculation in the render function

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unsupported or shader fails to compile
Fills its parent (h-full w-full), so the parent needs a defined height
Pointer listeners are attached to window, so cursor effects respond anywhere on the page while pointer is inside the container bounds
Ignores the pointer swirl when prefers-reduced-motion is set, and freezes motion
Default line color is white, so on light pages set colors or lightMode
Canvas is aria-hidden and decorative; text must be layered above it
Shader is GPU heavy at full screen, which may be slow on low-end mobile devices
Only the first 8 colors are used
